stem: The box plot summarizes the daily high temperatures, in degrees Fahrenheit, in a coastal city for the 31 days of May. What is the interquartile range of the daily high temperatures, in degrees Fahrenheit?
solution: The interquartile range is the third quartile minus the first quartile.
From the box plot, \(Q_{3} = 79\) and \(Q_{1} = 66\), so the interquartile range is \(79 - 66 = 13\).
verify:
b = figure['plots'][0]
iqr = b['q3'] - b['q1']
assert iqr == 13
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == iqr and len(spr_answers) == 1
